description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin Aeronautics is hiring an Early Career Software Engineer (Flight Controls) to develop and maintain safety-critical control law software and support flying-qualities analysis. The role also supports flight manual development and flight-control hardware system design, analysis, and testing.
Early Career Flight Controls Software Engineer developing safety-critical control laws, analyzing flying qualities, and supporting flight manuals and hardware testing

Responsibilities:
• Developing and maintaining safety critical control law software in accordance with applicable software development processes
• Performing flying qualities analysis and ensure that control laws satisfy flying qualities requirements for required flight conditions, aircraft loadings and environmental conditions
• Supporting flight manual development by defining operating limits, normal and emergency procedures, and system descriptions
• Supporting flight control hardware system design, analysis, and testing

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Aeronautical Engineering and/or a related discipline
• Coursework or experience in one of the following: Flight Dynamics, Controls, Simulation, AircraftGuidance, Flight Mechanics
• Experience with MATLAB/Simulink
• Must be a US Citizen; this position will require a government security clearance. This position islocated at a facility that requires special access
• The successful candidate will have experience and/or knowledge of aeronautical engineering, model-based design software, and MATLAB/Simulink, and be proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice

Preferred:
• Experience with C/C++ coding language
• Ability to work in a collaborative and team-based environment
• Proficient with Microsoft Office
